load_lora_weights_stable_diffusion: load LoRA weights into Stable Diffusion UNet and text encoder adapters
load_lora_weights_flux: load LoRA weights into Flux transformer and text encoder with format conversion
save_lora_weights: save LoRA adapter weights to disk in safetensors or pickle format
fuse_lora: fuse LoRA parameters into original model weights for faster inference
unload_lora_weights: unload LoRA adapters and reset transformer parameters to original state
